visualizations.title: 一个量子比特的线与面积 · 布洛赫球、旋子与双覆盖
visualizations.title_en: The line and the area of one qubit · Bloch sphere, rotors and the double cover
visualizations.summary: 在布洛赫球上拖动态矢量 B，对着量尺 A 看它的两个投影：共线的影子 A·B = cos θ 是“线”，决定探测器两种咔哒的比例；垂直撑开的面 |A∧B| = sin θ 是“面积”，决定干涉条纹的明暗对比；两者的平方和恒为 1。再给它加上量子门：每个门是一枚旋子，整个球绕固定轴转满 360° 时旋子差一个负号，转满 720° 才真正回来；H·Z·H 与 X 在球面上是同一个转动，旋子却是 −R_X。七张实验卡各讲其中一件事，可以在正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: Drag the state vector B on the Bloch sphere and read its two projections against the ruler A: the collinear shadow A·B = cos θ is the “line”, which sets the odds of the detector's two clicks; the perpendicular face |A∧B| = sin θ is the “area”, which sets the contrast of the interference fringes; their squares always sum to 1. Then add gates: each gate is a rotor, the rotor is off by a sign after a full 360° turn of the whole sphere about a fixed axis and returns only after 720°; H·Z·H and X are the same turn of the sphere, yet the rotor is −R_X. Each of the seven experiment cards makes one of these points and can be cited on its own from the text.

visualizations.title: 球外之球 · 有限的清单总留下一点在外面
visualizations.title_en: The sphere beyond the sphere · a finite list always leaves something outside
visualizations.summary: 六个场景画同一件事：有限步之后总有东西留在外面。对角线：逐行翻转对角元得到的串 d 与第 k 行在第 k 位不同，所以不在清单里；把 d 收编进去，新的对角线又翻出一个。纤维：四个地址的解码目录是满射，无论潜坐标怎么排，对角线 g 都劈开一根纤维，把 g 立成第二根轴后块数增加。割圆：内接正 n 边形（n = 6·2ᵏ，从刘徽的 6 边到祖冲之的 24576 边）与圆弧之间的缝 1 − cos(π/n) 永远大于零，放大镜一直把它放大到看得见。指针：N + 1 格的记录指针平移 ℓ 格后与自己的重叠不超过正 (⌊N/ℓ⌋ + 2) 边形的边心距，到不了 1。余弦：xₖ₊₁ = cos xₖ 的误差按等比缩小却不为零。素数：p₁⋯pₖ + 1 除以清单里每个素数都余 1，它的素因子都在清单之外。舞台下方的图画出“留在外面的量”随步数的变化。
visualizations.summary_en: Six scenes of one fact: after finitely many steps something is still outside. The diagonal: the string d obtained by flipping the diagonal bit of each row differs from row k in place k, so it is not on the list; absorb d and the new diagonal flips out another. The fibres: the four-address catalog is surjective, so however the latent coordinates are arranged the diagonal g splits a fibre, and raising g as a second axis adds blocks. The polygon: the gap 1 − cos(π/n) between the inscribed regular n-gon (n = 6·2ᵏ, from Liu Hui's 6 sides to Zu Chongzhi's 24576) and the arc is always positive, and a magnifier keeps it large enough to see. The pointer: a record pointer on N + 1 cells, shifted by ℓ, overlaps itself by at most the apothem of the regular (⌊N/ℓ⌋ + 2)-gon, never 1. The cosine: the error of xₖ₊₁ = cos xₖ shrinks geometrically and is never zero. The primes: p₁⋯pₖ + 1 leaves remainder 1 on every listed prime, so its prime factors are off the list. The plots under the stage show what is left outside, step by step.

visualizations.title: ±1 接缝 · 佩尔的一格、线素数与面素数、模 p 数点
visualizations.title_en: The ±1 seam · Pell's one cell, line primes and plane primes, points mod p
visualizations.summary: 沿着 ±1 接缝走一遍的三个场景。佩尔接缝：√d（无平方因子 2 ≤ d ≤ 37）的渐近分数 m/n 在格点上沿直线越贴越近，|m/n − √d| 趋于零，m² − d·n² 却是非零整数；两条色带末端的放大镜显示它们永远差着整数格，差值的符号来回翻转，连分数周期为奇数时才取得到 −1（d = 5 时灰圈标出落在 m² − 5n² = ±4 上的 (Fₖ, Lₖ)）。线素数与面素数：半径 √p 的圆上有格点当且仅当 p ≡ 1 (mod 4)，这时 a + bi 的平方给出整数直角三角形；格点的方向角 θ 是希尔伯特夹角，平方后的三角形转过布洛赫极角 2θ。模 p 数点：自旋环把勒让德符号 χₚ(f(x)) 画成一圈青色 +1、品红 −1 与中性 0，点数是 p + 1 + Σχ；曲线 y² = x³ − x 在 𝔽ₚ 上的 aₚ 被哈塞界 ±2√p 关住，线素数恰在零上，面素数的余弦等于高斯三角形的余弦；换成 y² = x³ − x + 1，余弦的分布贴近半圆律，p = 23 处明确标出坏约化（Δ = −368 = −2⁴·23）。
visualizations.summary_en: Three scenes along the ±1 seam. The Pell seam: on the lattice the convergents m/n of √d (squarefree 2 ≤ d ≤ 37) hug the line ever more closely, |m/n − √d| goes to zero, yet m² − d·n² is a nonzero integer; a magnifier on the ends of two bands shows that they always differ by whole cells, the sign of the gap flips back and forth, and −1 is reached only when the period of the continued fraction is odd (for d = 5 grey rings mark the pairs (Fₖ, Lₖ) on m² − 5n² = ±4). Line primes and plane primes: the circle of radius √p passes through lattice points exactly when p ≡ 1 (mod 4), and then the square of a + bi gives an integer right triangle; the direction θ of the lattice point is the Hilbert angle, and the squared triangle turns through the Bloch polar angle 2θ. Points mod p: a ring of spins draws the Legendre symbols χₚ(f(x)) as cyan +1, magenta −1 and neutral 0, and the count is p + 1 + Σχ; for the curve y² = x³ − x over 𝔽ₚ, aₚ is held inside Hasse's bound ±2√p, line primes sit exactly at zero and the cosine of a plane prime equals the cosine of its Gaussian triangle; for y² = x³ − x + 1 the cosines follow the semicircle law, and p = 23 is flagged as a prime of bad reduction (Δ = −368 = −2⁴·23).

visualizations.title: 没有时间的必然 · 格拉姆窗口、书页、场与线
visualizations.title_en: Necessity without time · the Gram window, a book of pages, a field and a thread
visualizations.summary: 同一颗球上的四个场景，另加第 30 章的两个平面场景。窗口：B 立在北极，A 与它夹角 θ₁，C 只能绕它转，于是 A·C = cos θ₁ cos θ₂ + sin θ₁ sin θ₂ cos φ 只能落在 [cos(θ₁ + θ₂), cos(θ₁ − θ₂)] 里；det G 是三根向量撑开的体积的平方，贴上窗边时三者共面、体积为零，窗外 det G 为负，没有向量能实现。书页：有限时钟上所有页同时画在球上，整本书在“拨一格”之下不变，条件化才取出读头下的那一页。场：势能 V = 1 − cos α 的梯度流从任何地方都流向目标，降下的势能等于走过的耗散。线：在 N = 2ⁿ 个候选里找一个目标，振幅放大每步只转 2θ，约 (π/4)√N 步到达。阶：随机 2-SAT 公式的消解闭包停在两元子句，随机 3-XOR / 3-SAT 的平方和松弛在阶 o(n) 内仍相容（文献结果，直线斜率为示意）。荒野：同一个自治场里，见证丝 y = h(x) 是精确的不变曲线，丝上的探针直达目标，通道外出发的探针被涡旋卷住（示意模型）。把它们读作“选择”“书页”“场”“线”与“见证丝”是本书第 29、30 章的诠释；图灵机意义下的 P ≠ NP 仍是开放问题，本页不推出它的任何答案。
visualizations.summary_en: Four scenes on one sphere, plus two plane scenes from chapter 30. The window: B stands at the north pole, A makes the angle θ₁ with it and C can only go around it, so A·C = cos θ₁ cos θ₂ + sin θ₁ sin θ₂ cos φ can only fall in [cos(θ₁ + θ₂), cos(θ₁ − θ₂)]; det G is the squared volume the three vectors span, zero at the edges of the window where they are coplanar and negative outside, where no vectors exist. The pages: on a finite clock all pages are drawn on the sphere at once, the whole book is unchanged by a tick, and conditioning picks the page under the reading head. The field: the gradient flow of V = 1 − cos α runs to the target from anywhere, and the potential it loses equals the dissipation it pays. The thread: to find one target among N = 2ⁿ candidates amplitude amplification turns only 2θ per step and arrives after about (π/4)√N steps. The order: the resolution closure of random 2-SAT formulas stays at two-literal clauses, while sum-of-squares relaxations of random 3-XOR / 3-SAT stay consistent up to order o(n) (a literature result; the slope of the line is schematic). The wilderness: in one autonomous field the witness thread y = h(x) is an exact invariant curve, the probe on it runs to the target, and probes started outside the channel are caught by vortices (a schematic model). Reading these as “choice”, “pages”, “field”, “thread” and “witness thread” is the interpretation of chapters 29 and 30 of this book; P ≠ NP in the sense of Turing machines remains open, and the page settles nothing about it.

visualizations.title: 场与涡丝 · 对流项的两半、越拉越细的涡管与算不出下一步的低频观察者
visualizations.title_en: Field and filament · the two halves of advection, a vortex tube drawn thin, and a low-mode observer who cannot predict the next step
visualizations.summary: 第 30 章流体一侧的三个场景。对流的两半：(u·∇)u 恒等于梯度 ∇(|u|²/2) 加兰姆项 ω × u，无旋时只剩梯度。涡管：二维里没有拉伸；三维里截面 A 变细而环量 Γ = ωA 不变，涡度按 Γ/A 变大，粘性按伯格斯涡的精确解 R(t)² = R∞² + (R₀² − R∞²)e^(−αt) 把涡核拦在 R∞ = √(4ν/α) ∝ Re^(−½)，示意的自拉伸模型在 κΓ > 4πν 时有限时间夹断；小图另画 K41 湍流统计标度 η/L ∼ Re^(−¾)、N ∼ Re^(9/4) 与模型能谱，两者是不同的事；三维无外力光滑解的全局正则性仍是开放问题。闭合：只看得见 x 的观察者能精确预测下一步，当且仅当三条泄漏同时为零（Lean 已验证）；五模态傅里叶实例里的混合项是 i/4。
visualizations.summary_en: Three scenes on the fluid side of chapter 30. The two halves of advection: (u·∇)u is the gradient ∇(|u|²/2) plus the Lamb term ω × u, and without vorticity only the gradient is left. The vortex tube: no stretching in two dimensions; in three the cross-section A shrinks while the circulation Γ = ωA stays, so the vorticity grows like Γ/A; viscosity holds the core at R∞ = √(4ν/α) ∝ Re^(−½) along the exact Burgers solution R(t)² = R∞² + (R₀² − R∞²)e^(−αt), and a schematic self-stretching model pinches in finite time when κΓ > 4πν; a small plot draws, separately, the K41 statistical scaling η/L ∼ Re^(−¾), N ∼ Re^(9/4) with a model spectrum; global regularity of unforced three-dimensional smooth solutions remains open. Closure: an observer who sees only x can predict the next step exactly iff three leaks vanish together (kernel-verified in Lean); in a five-mode Fourier instance the mixed term is i/4.

visualizations.title: 视界之外的交叉点 · 一条缓慢下降的指数率、桥图的最小割与少数承重的模态
visualizations.title_en: A crossover beyond the horizon · a slowly falling exponent rate, the minimal cut of a bridge graph and the few modes that carry the weight
visualizations.summary: 第 30 章 ETH 一节的三个场景。指数率：示意曲线 r(n) = c·log₂log₂n/√log₂n 趋于零却降得极慢，c = 1 时要到 n ≈ 2⁵⁵⁸ 才低于 PPSZ 的 0.386，远在宇宙原子数 2²⁶⁶ 之外；常数 c 决定交叉点在视界的哪一边；子句宽度 k = 3…6 只换 PPSZ 的基准线（唯一可满足情形的文献率 0.3863、0.5548、0.6502、0.7118）。桥图：宽度为 3 的双节点张量网络，每个随机整数实例的流矩阵的秩都不超过 Lean 的三项割上界 QMinCut = min(3ac, ad, bc)，也不超过第四道割 3bd（初等推导，未形式化），整张图的最小割是这四道的最小值；对自然数维数 0 < a ≤ b、0 < c ≤ d 且 a² + b² ≤ 3ab、c² + d² ≤ 3cd（锥域），能达到的最大秩等于 QMinCut = min(ad, bc) 已由 Lean 验证，但单次抽样的秩可以更低；锥域外须比较四道割。模态：非负且总和为迹预算 RW/π 的谱里，不小于阈值 τ 的模态至多 RW/(πτ) 个（Lean 已验证）；第 12 章引用它在几何谱 2^−(j+1)、τ = 1/8 上的情形：3 个过线，墙在 8。
visualizations.summary_en: Three scenes for the ETH section of chapter 30. The exponent rate: the schematic curve r(n) = c·log₂log₂n/√log₂n tends to zero but so slowly that for c = 1 it drops below the 0.386 of PPSZ only at n ≈ 2⁵⁵⁸, far beyond the 2²⁶⁶ atoms of the universe; the constant c decides on which side of the horizon the crossover lies; the clause width k = 3 … 6 only changes the PPSZ baseline (the literature rates of the uniquely satisfiable case, 0.3863, 0.5548, 0.6502, 0.7118). The bridge graph: a two-node tensor network of width 3 where the flow matrix of each random integer instance has rank at most Lean's three-term cut bound QMinCut = min(3ac, ad, bc) and at most the fourth cut 3bd (an elementary argument, not formalized), the minimal cut of the whole graph being the least of the four; that for natural-number dimensions with 0 < a ≤ b, 0 < c ≤ d, a² + b² ≤ 3ab and c² + d² ≤ 3cd (the cone) the greatest attainable rank equals QMinCut = min(ad, bc) is kernel-verified in Lean, though a single draw can fall lower; outside the cone the four cuts must be compared. The modes: in a nonnegative spectrum whose total is the trace budget RW/π, at most RW/(πτ) modes reach a threshold τ (kernel-verified in Lean); chapter 12 cites it on the geometric spectrum 2^−(j+1) at τ = 1/8: three clear the line, the wall stands at 8.

visualizations.summary: 终章“历史遗迹作为空间吸引子”一节，用洛伦兹系统演示。两轮：两条起点不同、参数相同的轨道落到同一对翅膀上，一次次回到同一处邻域；重返时两点相距小于 ε，单位切向的内积 cos δθ 接近 1。收缩：相空间体积按 e^(−41t/3) 缩小，500 个点被压成一张薄片。维数：李雅普诺夫指数的数值估计给出卡普兰—约克维数约 2.06；换成 ρ = 14，翅膀变成两个稳定点 C₊、C₋，参数相同时落进哪一个由起点所在的吸引域决定；换成 ρ = 160，吸引子变成一条闭合的环。本页是数值演示与诠释模型，不引用 Lean 定理。
visualizations.summary_en: The coda’s section on historical ruins as spatial attractors, shown with the Lorenz system. Rounds: two orbits with different starts and the same parameters land on the same pair of wings and return again and again to one neighbourhood; at a return the two points are less than ε apart and the inner product cos δθ of the unit tangents is close to 1. Contraction: phase volume shrinks like e^(−41t/3) and 500 points are pressed into a thin sheet. Dimension: numerical Lyapunov exponents give a Kaplan–Yorke dimension of about 2.06; at ρ = 14 the wings give way to two stable points C₊ and C₋, and with the same parameters the basin of the start decides which one is reached; at ρ = 160 the attractor becomes a closed loop. The page is a numerical illustration and an interpretive model; it cites no Lean theorem.

visualizations.title: 黄金切投 · 一条窗口从格点里切出的准晶、±1 接缝与有界间隙的回归
visualizations.title_en: The golden cut · a quasicrystal cut from a lattice by a window, the ±1 seam and returns with bounded gaps
visualizations.summary: 终章“黄金切投”一节的五个场景。切投：黄金整数 a + bφ 画成格点 (a + bφ, a + bψ)，一条长为 1 的窗口选出其中一些，投到直线上，相邻两点只相距 φ 或 φ²；挪动窗口，贴边的点翻转，深处的点不动；固定一小片就定住了远处的点。卡西尼：φ 的幂在同一张格点图里与原点围成的矩形，面积恒为 ±1。回归：按黄金角旋转的轨道以有界的间隔回到观测窗。接受窗：菱形三十面体，点离边界越远越稳（三维接受窗与“帝国”是文献结果）。缝：旋转的前 N 个点在圆周上切出的弧至多三种长度，黄金角的弧都长于 1/(√5·N)，π − 3 在 N = 114 切出极短的弧。下方条带列出自然数的齐肯多夫码，没有相邻的两个 1。灵魂与遗迹的说法是本书的诠释模型。
visualizations.summary_en: Five scenes for the coda’s section on the golden cut. Cut and project: the golden integers a + bφ are drawn as lattice points (a + bφ, a + bψ), a window of length 1 selects some of them, and projected to a line the neighbours are φ or φ² apart; move the window and points at its edge flip while deep points stay; fixing a small patch fixes distant points. Cassini: in the same lattice, the rectangle between the origin and a power of φ always has area ±1. Returns: an orbit turning by the golden angle comes back to an observation window with bounded gaps. The acceptance window: a rhombic triacontahedron, where a point is the safer the farther it is from the boundary (the three-dimensional window and the “empire” are literature results). Gaps: the first N points of a rotation cut the circle into arcs of at most three lengths; at the golden angle every arc is longer than 1/(√5·N), while π − 3 cuts a tiny arc at N = 114. A strip lists the Zeckendorf codes of the natural numbers, none with two adjacent 1s. What the page says about souls and ruins is an interpretive model of this book.

visualizations.summary: 布洛赫球里的一支箭头、一条测量线和与它垂直的对偶平面。按一次“投一次”，就是沿这条线测量而不读结果（P₊ρP₊ + P₋ρP₋，用 2×2 复矩阵实算）：箭头落到它在线上的影子，面上的那一份消失，箭头变短；再投多少次，影子都一动不动。箭头本来在线上就投不动，整个躺在对偶平面里就投成零；线上一份加面上一份拼回原箭头，纯度盈余等于概率偏离加剩余质量。另一种操作是读出结果、只留通过的一支：偏振片链里态每跳一次都留在球皮上，代价记在相乘的权重里。五张实验卡各讲一件事，可以在第三章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: Inside the Bloch ball: an arrow, a measurement line and the dual plane perpendicular to it. One press of “Project” is a measurement along the line whose result is not read (P₊ρP₊ + P₋ρP₋, computed with 2×2 complex matrices): the arrow drops to its shadow on the line, its part in the plane is gone and it gets shorter; press again as often as you like and the shadow does not move. An arrow already on the line cannot be moved, an arrow lying in the dual plane projects to zero, and the line part plus the plane part rebuild the arrow, so that the purity surplus is the probability deviation plus the residual mass. The other operation reads the result and keeps the branch that passed: along a chain of polarizers the state stays on the skin at every hop, and the price is booked in the multiplied weight. Each of the five experiment cards makes one of these points and can be cited on its own from Chapter 3.

visualizations.summary: 双缝后面放一个路径标记：左缝把它写成 r_L，右缝写成 r_R。在互补圆上拖动两者的夹角 α：青色的影子是屏上的条纹对比度 V = cos α；标记是纯态时，品红的高是路径可辨度 D = sin α，点始终在圆上，D² + V² = 1（Lean 已验证）。落点一个个到达屏上；读标记的方式可以等落点到齐再定：纯态标记在 α = 90° 时，按路径读，两行都没有条纹；按擦除方向读，同一批落点分成条纹与反条纹，合起来仍是原来的屏。标记本身带噪声（混合态）且 α > 0 时，点落进圆内，α = 0 时仍在圆上（Englert 不等式，文献结果）。六张实验卡各讲一件事，可以在正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: A path marker sits behind the double slit: the left slit writes it as r_L, the right one as r_R. Drag the angle α between them on the complementarity circle: the cyan shadow is the fringe contrast on the screen, V = cos α; for a pure marker the magenta height is the path distinguishability, D = sin α, and the point stays on the circle, D² + V² = 1 (kernel-verified in Lean). Hits arrive on the screen one by one; how to read the marker can wait until they are all in: for a pure marker at α = 90°, read it for the path and neither row shows fringes; read it to erase and the same hits split into fringes and anti-fringes that add up to the screen as it was. When the marker itself is noisy (mixed) and α > 0, the point falls inside the circle, and at α = 0 it stays on it (Englert's inequality, a literature result). Each of the six experiment cards makes one of these points and can be cited on its own from the text.

visualizations.title: 擦除账本
visualizations.title_en: The erasure ledger
visualizations.summary: 一个量子比特的布洛赫圆盘与一本两栏账：系统的熵、付给环境的热。转动不记账；捏合抹掉箭头横着的那一份（相干），系统的熵恰好多出这一步的相对熵 D，连做几步就一块块叠起来；理想复位把这笔熵化成热付给环境，正好碰到兰道尔下界；卡 ONE-QUBIT BATH 先把箭头捏成圆心，再只用一个 p = 0.9 的热浴比特交换复位，多付的一截恰好是热浴被推离平衡的 D，与第八章的数值表一致；卡 COPY · UNDO 把转 90° 后横躺的纯态拷贝进记录比特，局部的熵涨到 ln 2 却不付热，对角相同、相干相反的另一个态在局部与它重合，紧接着撤回（受控非门就是自己的伴随）便精确回到拷贝之前；卡 TWO STATES 把两个态送进同一串去极化、转动与捏合，它们的相对熵一步也不回升（数据处理不等式，Lean 已验证）。六张实验卡可以在第八章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: The Bloch disc of one qubit and a two-column ledger: the system's entropy and the heat paid to the environment. Turning writes nothing; pinching wipes out the arrow's sideways part (its coherence) and the system's entropy rises by exactly that step's relative entropy D, block by block over several steps; the ideal reset pays the entropy out as heat that just touches the Landauer floor; in the card ONE-QUBIT BATH, where the arrow is first pinched to the centre, resetting by a swap with a single bath qubit at p = 0.9 pays extra, exactly the D by which the bath is pushed off equilibrium, as in Chapter 8's table; in the card COPY · UNDO, copying the pure state turned flat by 90° into a record bit raises the local entropy to ln 2 with no heat at all, while a second state with the same diagonal and the opposite coherence coincides with it locally, and undoing it right away (the controlled-NOT is its own adjoint) restores the joint state exactly; the card TWO STATES sends two states through one chain of depolarizing, turning and pinching, and their relative entropy never rises (the data-processing inequality, kernel-verified in Lean). Each of the six experiment cards can be cited on its own from Chapter 8.

visualizations.title_en: Speed limits and the Zeno strobe
visualizations.summary: 三个场景共用一条时间轴。速度极限：左边把重叠 ⟨ψ(0), ψ(t)⟩ 画成每个能级一支首尾相接的箭头，圆心就是 90° 的墙；右边画夹角随时间的曲线、速度线 ΔH·t 与墙。二能级等权叠加贴着速度线在 t = π 撞墙，三能级等权叠加弯着走、到 2.094 才撞墙，不等权叠加最多转到 2α。芝诺频闪：布洛赫球上的箭头每转 180°/N 就被拉回 |0⟩，全程留存 [cos²(π/2N)]^N 随 N 增大。首次返回：每一步问一次“回来了吗”，每根账目柱的已返回加未返回恰好是 1，平均返回时间对任何步长都是 2。六张实验卡各讲一件事，可以在第七章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: Three scenes on one rail. Speed limit: on the left the overlap ⟨ψ(0), ψ(t)⟩ is drawn as one arrow per level, head to tail, and the centre is the 90° wall; on the right the angle rises against time below the speed line ΔH·t towards the wall. Two even levels run along the speed line into the wall at t = π, three even levels bend and reach it only at 2.094, and uneven weights turn at most 2α. Zeno strobe: on the Bloch sphere the arrow is pulled back to |0⟩ after every 180°/N, and the survival [cos²(π/2N)]^N grows with N. First return: ask “back yet?” after every step; returned plus not yet is exactly 1 on every column of the ledger, and the mean return time is 2 whatever the step. visualizations.title_en: Two-angle addressing and rotation words
visualizations.summary: 从北极 N 出发，先绕水平轴 e₂ 倾转 θ、再绕竖轴 e₃ 拧转 φ，就到达球面上任一点 r(θ, φ)；第二步只沿高度 cos θ 不变的纬度圈走，在两极则白拧一圈。两根转轴斜着时，页面按一条贪心规则当场构造旋转字：每次绕 b 的转动最多把点推离 N 2α，所以夹角越小要转的次数越多，而两轴共线时 N 寸步难移。“覆盖”场景在同一颗球上画出六根有理轴的 12 个 45° 球冠：它们盖住整颗球，与当前点正交的大圆不进入含它的任何球冠；三根坐标轴的球冠则在卦限对角线处漏缝。Lie–Trotter 一卡把绕两根正交轴的转动各切成 n 份交替做，读出乘积的转角、转轴与误差，看它贴近生成元相加的那一次转动。八张实验卡各讲其中一件事，可以在正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: From the north pole N, tilt by θ about the horizontal axis e₂ and then twist by φ about the vertical axis e₃, and you reach any point r(θ, φ) of the sphere; the second turn runs along the latitude circle of fixed height cos θ, and at the poles it does nothing. With skew axes the page builds a rotation word on the spot by a greedy rule: each turn about b pushes the point at most 2α further from N, so a smaller angle between the axes needs more turns, and collinear axes cannot move N at all. The “Cover” scene draws, on the same sphere, the 12 caps of 45° around six rational axes: they cover the whole sphere, and the great circle orthogonal to the current point enters none of the caps that hold it; the caps of the three coordinate axes leave gaps at the octant diagonals. The Lie–Trotter card cuts the turns about two orthogonal axes into n slices each, alternates them, and reads off the angle, axis and error of the product as it closes in on the one rotation obtained by adding the generators. Each of the eight experiment cards makes one of these points and can be cited on its own from the text.

visualizations.title_en: Loops on the sphere and the Berry phase
visualizations.summary: 布洛赫球面上一条由大圆弧连成、顶点可拖动的闭合回路。琥珀色的箭头沿回路平行移动，与沿“起点 → 内点 → 当前点”搬来的虚线参照相比，随时多转出品红扇形已扫过的面积；走回起点时，它转过的角正好是回路圈住的立体角 Ω。相邻顶点复内积的连乘积 Δ 的相位只记下一半：八分之一球 N → +X → +Y 的 Ω = π/2、arg Δ = π/4；赤道一圈 Ω = 2π，箭头看似没转、实则转满一周，四个相邻内积都是 (1 + i)/2，相位为 π；反着走，角与相位都变号而模平方一个不变。另有两种转序的对照（先 Y 后 X 停在 +X，先 X 后 Y 停在 −Y）与只在两极为零的箭头场。五张实验卡可以在第十章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: A closed loop of great-circle arcs with draggable corners on the Bloch sphere. The amber arrow is carried along it; compared with the dashed reference carried along start → inside point → current point, it gets ahead by exactly the magenta area the fan has swept, and back at the start it has turned by the solid angle Ω the loop encloses. The product Δ of the complex inner products of neighbouring corners keeps half of that in its phase: the octant N → +X → +Y has Ω = π/2 and arg Δ = π/4; once round the equator Ω = 2π, the arrow seems not to have turned yet has turned a full circle, all four neighbouring inner products are (1 + i)/2 and the phase is π; walked backwards, the angle and the phase flip sign while not one squared modulus changes. Two rotation orders (Y then X ends at +X, X then Y at −Y) and a tangent field that vanishes only at the poles complete the page. visualizations.title: 脉冲面积与虚拟 Z
visualizations.title_en: Pulse area and the virtual Z
visualizations.summary: 左边是微波脉冲的包络，右边是布洛赫球：在旋转参考系里，固定相位的共振脉冲把态绕赤道上的一根轴转过的角，就是包络下的面积（品红）。方波 25 ns、10 MHz 的面积 π/2 是四分之一转，同面积的高斯波停在同一点，面积 π 是半转；卡 DETUNED 里同一个从北极出发、面积 π/2、25 ns 的高斯包络失谐 5 MHz，转轴随包络晃动，终点与不失谐的终点差了约 26°；两个不同相位的脉冲换个次序，终点可能不同（如共振时从北极出发，先 X 后 Y 与先 Y 后 X 的两个 π/2 方波）。不加驱动、只有 H₀ 自由演化时，实验室系里赤道上的态每 0.2 ns 绕竖轴一圈，两极是 H₀ 的本征态，不动（Lean 已证的本征态定态性）。虚拟 Z 不发脉冲，只把后面脉冲的相位改成 φ − λ：把终点绕 z 轴转 λ 就是电路字面的终点（落在两极的终点不动），高度相同，Z 基读数相同；符号改错成 φ + λ，读数可能改变：从 |+⟩ 出发、λ = 90°、X(π/2) 时，终点从北极换到南极。八张实验卡各讲其中一件事，可以在正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: On the left the envelope of a microwave pulse, on the right the Bloch sphere: in the rotating frame a resonant pulse of fixed phase turns the state about an axis on the equator by an angle equal to the area under the envelope (magenta). A 25 ns, 10 MHz square pulse has area π/2 and makes a quarter turn, a Gaussian of the same area stops at the same point, and area π is a half turn; in the card DETUNED the same Gaussian of area π/2 over 25 ns, started from the north pole and detuned by 5 MHz, has its axis sway with the envelope and misses the undetuned end by about 26°; two pulses of different phase can end elsewhere when swapped (resonant, from the north pole: two π/2 square pulses, X then Y against Y then X). With no drive, under the free evolution by H₀ alone, a state on the equator goes round the vertical axis every 0.2 ns in the lab frame while the poles, eigenstates of H₀, stay put (the stationarity of eigenstates, proved in Lean). A virtual Z sends no pulse and only shifts the later pulses to phase φ − λ: turning the end point by λ about z gives the end of the circuit taken literally (an end on a pole stays put), so the height and the Z readout are the same; with the wrong sign φ + λ the readout can change: from |+⟩ with λ = 90° and X(π/2), the end moves from the north pole to the south pole. Each of the eight experiment cards makes one of these points and can be cited on its own from the text.

visualizations.summary: 在 d 维实单位球面上均匀取点，看它们在一根固定测量轴上的坐标 x₁：左边把每个点按 x₁ 放在过测量轴的圆截面上，右边横着画 x₁ 的精确密度与直方图。三维时高度均匀分布；维数 d = 2ⁿ 升高，点挤向垂直于测量轴的赤道，宽度按 1/√d 缩小。马尔可夫上界 1/(dε²) 总在精确的带外份额之上：二十个量子比特、ε = 0.1 时界是 9.54 × 10⁻⁵，精确值约 3 × 10⁻²²⁹¹；维数高到鼓包看不清时，放大镜把赤道附近放大 √d 倍。赤道集中、马尔可夫上界与贫瘠高原都是文献结果，页面不画梯度。四张实验卡可以在第十二章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: Pick points uniformly on the real unit sphere in d dimensions and look at their coordinate x₁ along one fixed measured axis: on the left each point sits at its x₁ on the section of the sphere through the axis, on the right the exact density of x₁ and the histogram are drawn sideways. In three dimensions the heights are spread evenly; as d = 2ⁿ grows the points crowd onto the equator perpendicular to the axis, in a belt that shrinks like 1/√d. The Markov bound 1/(dε²) always lies above the exact outside share: at twenty qubits and ε = 0.1 the bound is 9.54 × 10⁻⁵ and the exact share about 3 × 10⁻²²⁹¹; once the bump is too thin to see, a magnifier enlarges the equator √d times. Equator concentration, the Markov bound and barren plateaus are literature results, and the page draws no gradients. Each of the four experiment cards can be cited on its own from Chapter 12.

visualizations.title_en: Pairwise measurement and shutter counts
visualizations.summary: 布洛赫球上两支箭头：青色的 A 是已知态，琥珀色的 B 是目标态，两者之间只有一个角 θ。快门每次只报“过”（+1）或“不过”（−1），一次过不过说不准；按得越多，“过”的比例 k/N 越贴近权重 p = Tr(ρ_A P_B) = (1 + cos θ)/2：B 向 A 的直径作垂线，垂足把直径分出的青色一段就是 p。共线时每次都过，对跖时一次也不过，90° 时一半一半而晃得最厉害；两支一起转，权重与计数都不变；B 每次取随机方向时，权重在 [0, 1] 上均匀分布。六张实验卡各讲其中一件事，可以在正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: Two arrows on the Bloch sphere: the cyan A is the known state, the amber B the target, and between them there is just one angle θ. Each shot of the shutter reports only “pass” (+1) or “fail” (−1), and no single shot can be foretold; the more shots, the closer the share of passes k/N comes to the weight p = Tr(ρ_A P_B) = (1 + cos θ)/2, which is the cyan stretch cut off on A's diameter by the foot of B's perpendicular. Collinear arrows pass every time, antipodal ones never, at 90° it is half and half with the widest wobble; turning both together changes neither the weight nor the counts; with a random direction for B at every shot the weight is uniform on [0, 1]. Each of the six experiment cards makes one of these points and can be cited on its own from the text.

visualizations.title: CHSH 角度盘
visualizations.title_en: The CHSH angle dial
visualizations.summary: Alice 与 Bob 在同一张角度盘上各摆两个测量方向。贝尔态 |Φ⁺⟩ 上两方向的关联是夹角的余弦，CHSH 值是四个余弦的加减，在量尺上一段段叠起来。两侧各张开一块面积（|sin α| 与 |sin β|），它们决定这组方向的天花板 √(4 + 4|sin α sin β|)：Alice 的两个方向重合时天花板落在 2，两侧都张成直角时升到 2√2，再把 Bob 的十字架转 45°，四个余弦正好叠到 2√2。换成 360 个隐方向的经典模型，每个隐方向只给 +2 或 −2，平均怎么转都越不过 2；余弦弧与经典折线在 45° 与 135° 的四段之差合计 2√2 − 2。六张实验卡可以在第十三章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: On one dial Alice and Bob each set two measurement directions. On the Bell state |Φ⁺⟩ two directions correlate as the cosine of their angle, and the CHSH value adds and subtracts four cosines, stacked step by step on a gauge. Each side opens an area (|sin α| and |sin β|), and these set the ceiling √(4 + 4|sin α sin β|) of the chosen directions: at 2 when Alice's two directions coincide, at 2√2 when both sides open a right angle; turn Bob's cross by 45° and the four cosines stack exactly to 2√2. Against a classical model of 360 hidden directions, each giving only +2 or −2, the mean never exceeds 2 however the directions turn; the four gaps between the cosine arc and the classical polyline at 45° and 135° add up to 2√2 − 2. Each of the six experiment cards can be cited on its own from Chapter 13.

visualizations.title: 游走扩散
visualizations.title_en: How walks spread
visualizations.summary: 同一条线（一个足够长的圈 ZMod p）上，量子游走与经典随机游走从同一个原点出发，并排画在线的上下两侧。量子的一份按正文的 Hadamard 单步规则带着硬币相干地走，两个尖峰贴着 ±n 往外跑，宽度按步数 n 线性长大；经典的一份每步左右各 ½，宽度只按 √n 长大，走 50 步时两者相差 3.83 倍。硬币取 c* = (1, i)/√2 时每一对镜像模式 (0, x)、(1, −x) 都均分概率，分布左右对称；换成同样一半一半的实硬币 (1, 1)/√2，分布就偏向一边；“镜像对”场景把每一对的两段叠成一根柱，总高与硬币无关，c* 时两段等高。圈只有 9 个点时游走绕回来，对称仍在。四张实验卡可以在第十六章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: On one line (a long enough cycle ZMod p) a quantum walk and a classical random walk start from the same origin, drawn above and below the line. The quantum one follows the text's Hadamard step, moving coherently with its coin: its two peaks run out next to ±n and its width grows linearly in the number of steps n. The classical one steps left or right with probability ½ and widens only like √n; after fifty steps they are 3.83 times apart. With the coin c* = (1, i)/√2 every mirror pair of modes (0, x), (1, −x) splits its probability evenly and the distribution is symmetric; a real coin (1, 1)/√2, half and half as well, tilts it to one side. The scene “Pairs” stacks the two modes of each pair into one bar: its height does not depend on the coin, and with c* the two parts are equal. On a cycle of only nine points the walk wraps round and the symmetry stays. Each of the four experiment cards can be cited on its own from Chapter 16.

visualizations.summary: 从北极出发，用 H 与 T 两个门拼出长度不超过 L 的门字，每个门字把北极送到布洛赫球面上的一点（按第十六章例题的转动 R_H、R_T 逐层算出，每点标出最短门字）。这些点只有有限个：点数 1、2、3、5、8、13、19……远小于 2^(L+1) − 1。它们的凸包是内接于球的平直多面体：门长 1 是一条线段，门长 3 第一次成为立体却不含球心，从门长 5 起包住球心，可把棱投回球皮成为测地网格。拖动琥珀色的目标，品红的弧与半径段给出它到最近可达点的角度与径向间隙 1 − h；切到最坏方向，品红虚线圈出最大的空球冠 ε_L，它随 L 一级级缩小（L = 20 时 971 个点，ε = 9.10°），却在任何有限 L 下都不为零。五张实验卡可以在第十六章正文里单独引用。

There are only finitely many: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 19, … points, far below 2^(L+1) − 1. Their convex hull is a flat polytope inscribed in the sphere: at length 1 it is a segment, at length 3 it is solid for the first time but misses the centre, and from length 5 on it holds the centre, so that its edges project onto the sphere as a geodesic mesh. Drag the amber target, and the magenta arc and piece of radius give its angle to the nearest reachable point and the radial gap 1 − h; switch to the worst direction, and dashed magenta circles the largest empty cap ε_L, which shrinks step by step with L (971 points and ε = 9.10° at L = 20) yet never vanishes for a finite L. visualizations.summary: Grover 搜索的每一步是两面镜子：先对失败轴照一次，再对初始态 |s⟩ 那条线照一次，合起来在目标与失败两轴张成的平面里转 2θ，sin θ = 1/√N；第 n 步后箭头停在 (2n + 1)θ，在目标轴上的影子就是成功振幅。N = 4 一步正好立在目标上；N = 8 两步之后成功概率 121/128，第三步转过了头；N = 256 时十二小步爬到 0.99995，第一个峰的步数紧跟 π√N/4。四张实验卡可以在第十五章正文里单独引用。

N = 4 lands exactly on the target in one step; N = 8 reaches 121/128 after two steps and overshoots on the third; N = 256 climbs to 0.99995 in twelve small steps, and the first-peak step count follows π√N/4. visualizations.title: 相位齿轮与周期
visualizations.title_en: Phase gears and the period
visualizations.summary: 量子傅里叶变换给寄存器里的每一格 x 拧一排相位齿轮：第一只每格转半圈，往后每只慢一半；频率 k 的相位是 k 的二进制位选中的那几只齿轮的转角之和，Q = 8、x = 5 时三只齿轮停在 π、π/2、5π/4。把周期梳子上各格的相位箭头首尾相接：r 整除 Q、梳子为完整陪集（x₀ < r）时不共振的频率绕成闭合的多边形、合成为零（Q = 16、k = 1 正是 1 + i − 1 − i = 0），谱上只剩 r 根等高的峰；r 不整除 Q 时只有一部分 sQ/r 落在整数上，谱是梳子实际各格箭头的有限和（例如 Q = 64、r = 6、x₀ = 0 时峰摊在 sQ/r 附近）；截短的梳子未必集中在 sQ/r 附近，只剩一格时谱是平的；连分数从峰读出的阶只是候选，要再检验。Q = 32、周期 8 时位置梳子只有 4 格，谱上却有 8 根峰，峰距是 Q/r = 4 而不是 r。六张实验卡可以在第十五章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: The quantum Fourier transform turns a row of phase gears for every cell x of the register: the first turns half a turn per cell and each next one half as fast; the phase of frequency k is the sum of the angles of the gears picked by the binary digits of k, and at Q = 8, x = 5 the three gears rest at π, π/2 and 5π/4. Chain the phase arrows of the cells of a periodic comb head to tail: when r divides Q and the comb is a complete coset (x₀ < r) every off-resonant frequency closes into a polygon and sums to zero (Q = 16, k = 1 is exactly 1 + i − 1 − i = 0), leaving r equal peaks; when r does not divide Q only some of the values sQ/r are integers and the spectrum is the finite sum over the comb's actual cells (for example, at Q = 64, r = 6, x₀ = 0 the peaks spread near sQ/r); a truncated comb need not concentrate near sQ/r, and a single cell gives a flat spectrum; the order read from a peak by continued fractions is only a candidate to be checked. With Q = 32 and period 8 the comb of positions has only 4 cells while the spectrum has 8 peaks, Q/r = 4 apart rather than r. Each of the six experiment cards can be cited on its own from Chapter 15.

visualizations.summary_en: Chapter 19's layered tensor network: thirty-two boundary sites under a binary MERA-like network with open ends (squares are disentanglers, triangles isometries), every bond of the same dimension. Drag the amber interval on the boundary; the page finds by augmenting paths the fewest bonds whose cutting separates it from the rest of the boundary, draws that minimal cut in magenta and the tensors inside it in cyan. One site cuts its own leg; four sites are cut off by 3 bonds running inside the network; as the interval grows from 1 site to 16 the cut grows only from 1 bond to 8, and none of the 527 intervals needs more than 2·log₂L + 1; for two intervals two sites apart, cutting them together is cheaper once A reaches 7 sites. The rank bound χᵏ across a cut and the MERA/RT analogy are marked as literature results, as in chapter 19; green is given only to the verified bound rank ≤ minimal cut on the width-three bridge graph. visualizations.title: 刀片乘法

visualizations.summary: Cl(3,0) 的 8 块基刀片记成 3 位掩码，排成 8 × 8 的乘法表：乘积是哪一块只看两个掩码的异或，正负号只看排序时要交换几次。点表里的一格，舞台右边把这一乘积拆开：左右因子拼成一串，右因子逐个向左越过比它大的左因子，每交换一次两条线交叉一次、符号变一次；排好后同号相邻的一对按 eᵢ² = +1 抵掉，剩下的就是异或。e₂ · e₁ = −e₁₂ 交换一次；e₁₂ · e₁₂ = −1；伪标量 I₃ · I₃ 交换 0 + 1 + 2 = 3 次得 −1，I₃ 那一行与那一列逐格相同。只用两位（X、Z）时就是四个泡利字的乘法表，负号恰在左因子含 Z、右因子含 X 的四格，即合成律 D(a, b)·D(c, d) = (−1)^(bc)·D(a ⊕ c, b ⊕ d)。向量场景把 v = 3e₁ + 4e₂ + 12e₃ 自乘的九项逐一加进来：交叉项成对抵消，v² = 169，与 B(3, 4, 12)² = 169·I 一致。每一格都与 2 × 2 复矩阵的乘积核对。五张实验卡可以在第二十五章正文里单独引用。
visualizations.summary_en: The 8 basis blades of Cl(3,0), written as 3-bit masks, fill an 8 × 8 multiplication table: which blade the product is depends only on the XOR of the two masks, and its sign only on how many swaps sorting needs. Click a cell and the right of the stage takes that product apart: the factors are joined into one string, each right factor moves left past the larger left factors, every swap is two crossing lines and one sign flip, and once sorted each adjacent equal pair cancels by eᵢ² = +1, leaving the XOR. e₂ · e₁ = −e₁₂ takes one swap; e₁₂ · e₁₂ = −1; the pseudoscalar I₃ · I₃ takes 0 + 1 + 2 = 3 swaps and gives −1, and the row and the column of I₃ agree cell by cell. With two bits (X, Z) it is the multiplication table of the four Pauli words, with minus signs exactly where the left factor contains Z and the right one X: the composition law D(a, b)·D(c, d) = (−1)^(bc)·D(a ⊕ c, b ⊕ d). The vector scene adds the nine terms of v = 3e₁ + 4e₂ + 12e₃ squared one at a time: the cross terms cancel in pairs and v² = 169, in agreement with B(3, 4, 12)² = 169·I. Every cell is checked against 2 × 2 complex matrices. Each of the five experiment cards can be cited on its own from Chapter 25.

visualizations.summary: 有限观察者记住 M 步历史，挑下一步就是补全一张 (M+1) × (M+1) 的格拉姆表，它必须半正定。舞台是三元格拉姆椭圆体（鼓胀的四面体 1 − x² − y² − z² + 2xyz ≥ 0）与它在历史 x = P₀·P₋₁ 处的截面：每多记一个更早的锚点，候选 Q 的 (y, z) 就多一圈品红的椭圆约束，套在上一圈里面，穿过 Q 的 z 的窗口一圈圈收窄。把 z 填到某一圈之外，按 Q, P₀, P₋₁, … 的顺序，第一个变负的顺序主子式正好指出是哪一层记忆拒绝了它。事件取在 ℝ⁶ = E∥ ⊕ E⊥ 中，M = 1 … 5 每一层都还有内部；压回三维时四根以上的向量撑不出体积，泡泡只剩边界和孤立的点。半正定判据与椭圆体的刻画是文献结果，把 G ⪰ 0 读作因果相容空间是本书第 29 章的诠释。
visualizations.summary_en: A finite observer remembering M steps of history chooses the next step by completing an (M+1) × (M+1) Gram table, which must be positive semidefinite. The stage is the three-element Gram elliptope (the swollen tetrahedron 1 − x² − y² − z² + 2xyz ≥ 0) and its slice at the history's x = P₀·P₋₁: each older anchor remembered adds a magenta ellipse constraining the candidate Q's (y, z), nested inside the last, and the window for z through Q narrows ring by ring. Fill z in outside one of the rings and, in the order Q, P₀, P₋₁, …, the first leading principal minor to turn negative says exactly which depth of memory refuses it. The events live in ℝ⁶ = E∥ ⊕ E⊥, so every depth M = 1 … 5 keeps an inside; squeezed back into three dimensions, four or more vectors span no volume and the bubble keeps only its edge and isolated points. The semidefiniteness criteria and the description of the elliptope are literature results; reading G ⪰ 0 as the causally compatible space is the interpretation of chapter 29 of this book.

visualizations.summary: 为什么反复取余弦逼近 θ* ≈ 0.7391 的过程很像斐波那契黄金螺旋？因为两者的不动点导数都严格为负（−sin θ* ≈ −0.6736 与 −φ⁻² ≈ −0.3820）：蛛网平面上每一步竖走到曲线、横走回对角线 y = x 的两臂严格等长 |Bₖ − Aₖ| = |Aₖ₊₁ − Bₖ| = |f(xₖ) − xₖ|（每步走两臂绕 (x*, x*) 转 180°，从 x₀ < x* 出发按“北 → 东 → 南 → 西”同向转向，从 x₀ > x* 出发移相两象限为“南 → 西 → 北 → 东”），嵌套出回旋方格与分段 90° 圆弧导引线。对照光滑等角对数螺旋模型 R(φ) = R₀e⁻ᵇᵠ，θ* 正交螺旋每转 90° 按 sin θ* ≈ 0.6736 收缩（向心径向切角 α ≈ 75.88°），黄金螺旋按 φ⁻¹ ≈ 0.6180 收缩（向心切角 72.97°），蛛网双步螺旋按 √(sin θ*) ≈ 0.8207 收缩（向心切角 82.83°），与 90.00° 闭合圆并排；平直一维满足加法守恒 φ⁻¹ + φ⁻² = 1，弯上单位圆则化为二维勾股平方守恒 (θ*)² + sin²θ* = 1。六张实验卡可在第二十四章与第三十二章正文里单独引用。
